svg.title: Adjacent Equipment Plays Roadmap
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-08-adjacent-models-roadmap; chapter number: 12; title: Adjacent Equipment Plays Roadmap; subtitle: Buy or broker what the market mislabeled; own the buyer network; chart type: timeline_roadmap; weeks: week: Week 1; title: Source surplus iron; deliverable: Bid list with demil codes read first; DEMIL A and Q transfer intact, and some Code H dozer fixes start with a $10 filter.; gate: Data plate matched to the DLA catalog; milky fluids, pin bosses, and grouser height checked.; week: Week 2; title: Source salvage units; deliverable: Underwater units bought from insurers and salvagedsale.com; one flood machine has run about 2,000 hours since.; gate: Burned machines skipped entirely.; week: Week 3; title: Structure the auction or consignment; deliverable: 6% seller fee plus 10% buyer premium, $3,200 on a $20K machine; seller proceeds never touch the operating account.; gate: No net guarantee without reserves; $620K in comps produced a $375K sale and a $150K hit.; week: Week 4; title: Exit through export or parts; deliverable: Excavators shipped only on 50/50 terms; a $1,500 F-150 parted out for $4,000.; gate: Verified buyer and purchase order locked; galamsey buyers refused.; caption: Plain Finance reports $500K in year three from its auction house; Jermane Cheathem reports $50M+ in brokered equipment deals.; assumptions note: Week grouping is an organizing sequence; practitioners did not report weekly timing. F-150 operating profit of about $1,400 is net of $150 tow, $600 labor, and $350 other costs.; note: Sources - EquipmentWorld, Vantor Surplus, Plain Finance, CapitalCode, SwiftBridge Trading LLP, and Jermane Cheathem.
